# NeonClipping
**Paste a link. Get captioned 9:16 clips in about two minutes. Free, local, open-source.**
NeonClipping turns long YouTube / Twitch / Kick videos (or your own MP4) into vertical, captioned clips with a title and hook for each. Everything runs on your machine: no account, no subscription, no upload.
[ ](https://github.com/iamajmeena/neonclipping) [ ](https://www.instagram.com/iamajmeena/)
🌐 **Website with one-click Windows setup:**  
**Made by [Ajay K Meena](https://www.instagram.com/iamajmeena/)** (Director, DOP, colorist, DaVinci Resolve educator, Jaipur). If NeonClipping saves you time, please ⭐ star the repo and follow [@iamajmeena](https://www.instagram.com/iamajmeena/) on Instagram.
**Clip an 85-minute stream in 97 seconds, 100% locally, with zero API cost.** (measured, see [How it finds good moments](#how-it-finds-good-moments))
### NeonClipping compared with other clippers
| | **NeonClipping** | OpusClip (cloud) | Docker-based self-hosted clippers (SupoClip, OpenShorts, Reelsaw) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Where it runs | Your PC, nothing uploaded | Their servers | Your machine or server |
| Cost | Free, no account, no credits | Subscription / credits | Free (some need an LLM API key or Docker setup) |
| Install | One `.bat` on Windows, `install.sh` on Mac/Linux, no Docker | None (web) | Docker |
| YouTube + Twitch + Kick links | Yes | Yes | Mostly YouTube |
| Very long streams | Audio-first (79 MB for 85 min); 24 h video: pick the part, never downloads all | Upload limits apply | Often limited by length or disk |
| Gaming layouts (facecam + gameplay) | 11 layouts, automatic facecam finder | Limited | Varies |
| Live stream clipping | Yes, chat-spike based, phone remote | No | Rarely |
| Download quality | 1080p default, 4K option beside Get preview | n/a | Varies |
| Captions | 5 styles, 52 languages, Hinglish, on/off, quiet-part aware | Templates | Varies |
📘 **Guides (Hindi + English, PDF):** [docs/NeonClipping-Guide-EN-HI.pdf](docs/NeonClipping-Guide-EN-HI.pdf)  
🤖 **Let an AI agent install it for you:** copy [docs/NEONCLIPPING-AGENT-SETUP-PROMPT.txt](docs/NEONCLIPPING-AGENT-SETUP-PROMPT.txt) into Claude Code, Codex CLI or Cursor.
## How it finds good moments
Two modes, one button.
**⚡ Fast mode (default, videos over 10 min)** copies the trick that makes the fastest clippers fast: never look at the whole video.

top10.descricao_en: Open-source browser extension that flags AI-generated images and video as you browse. Runs entirely on your device. Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
top10.readme:
Hikaku 
   Spot signs of AI. As you browse.  
  A browser extension that quietly flags AI-generated images and video, and shows you why. Everything runs on your device.
   hikaku.io  ·
   Download  ·
   Architecture  ·
   Models  ·
   Benchmark  ·
   Contributing 
    Hikaku on a real listings page. The street address is fictional, and a flag is the model's estimate, not proof. 
> *hikaku* (比較) is Japanese for "comparison". The idea is to weigh what an image claims to be against the evidence it carries.
## Features
| Status | Feature | Notes |
|:---:|---|---|
| ✅ | **Content Credentials (C2PA)** | JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4/MOV, AVIF/HEIC. Parsed locally; signatures not yet verified. |
| ✅ | **IPTC / XMP / EXIF provenance** | `trainedAlgorithmicMedia`, "Made with … AI", generator names in tool fields |
| ✅ | **Embedded generation parameters** | Automatic1111, ComfyUI, InvokeAI, NovelAI |
| ✅ | **On-device visual model** | SwinV2 detector via ONNX Runtime; WebGPU (fp16) or WASM (uint8) |
| ✅ | **Video**, including streamed (YouTube, TikTok…) | 3 sampled frames per visible video, median score |
| ✅ | **Animated GIF / WebP** | First / middle / last frame, median score |
| ✅ | **Screenshot & flat-graphic filter** | Skips likely screenshots, UI and flat graphics before inference |
| ✅ | **Flag styles** | Border (solid / double / dashed) or corner dot; preset and custom colors; hover card; details panel; Copy JSON |
| ✅ | **Right-click → Inspect for AI generation** | Works on any image or video |
| 🚧 | **Face-swap / deepfake detection** | Face finder + per-face model, [under evaluation](docs/MODELS.md#candidates-under-evaluation) |
| ✅ | **On-demand second opinion** | Separate 23 MB Community Forensics model; requested in image details, not an automatic replacement |
| 📋 | **C2PA signature verification** | Today credentials are read, not cryptographically verified |
| 📋 | **Platform AI labels** | YouTube "Altered or synthetic", TikTok/Meta "AI info" |
| 📋 | **AI-written text detection** | |
| 🚧 | **Store listings** | Check [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/hikaku/) for availability; browser-specific packages are on GitHub releases |
✅ working · 🚧 in progress · 📋 planned

top10.descricao_en: A local inference engine for Apple silicon, built around the model.
top10.readme:
# Splash
[ ](https://github.com/incoai/splash/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](#quick-start)
**A local inference engine for Apple silicon, built around the model.**
Splash runs coding agents and OpenAI or Anthropic compatible applications on
one Mac. It combines [DFlash 2](https://inco.ai/blog/dflash2/) speculative
decoding, specialized Metal kernels, and automatic memory planning, with
vision, tool calling, and a built-in chat page.
It reuses cached prefixes and batches concurrent requests automatically.
## Quick start
[Download the Splash desktop app](https://github.com/incoai/splash/releases/latest/download/Splash.dmg)
for an Apple M3 or newer on macOS 26.4 or later, open the disk image and drag
Splash into Applications.
The command line needs the same Mac and [Homebrew](https://brew.sh):
```bash
brew install incoai/tap/splash
splash serve --model unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_M
```
The first run downloads the model and its matching draft and starts serving
on `127.0.0.1:8000`. Later starts reuse the downloads; leave room on disk for
them ([storage requirements](docs/server.md#model-storage)).
Once it prints `Ready`, leave this terminal open. Open  
in your browser, or run an installed coding agent from another terminal:
```bash
splash opencode    # or: splash claude / splash codex / splash hermes / splash pi
```
For a server started with another `--port`, pass the same `--port` to the agent.
Press Ctrl+C in the server terminal to stop Splash.
For LM Studio Bionic, follow its [Splash setup guide](https://lmstudio.ai/blog/splash-engine).
## Use the API
OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Completions, and Anthropic Messages,
with streaming, tool calls, JSON Schema output, and base64 images and PDFs:
```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model": "unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_M",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Explain speculative decoding in one sentence."}]
  }'
```
Reasoning follows the model default; `"reasoning_effort": "none"` turns it off
in Chat. Anthropic Messages requests reason only when they set `thinking`.
[Reasoning settings](docs/server.md#default-reasoning-effort) ·
[Tool calls](docs/api.md#tool-calls) ·
[API details](docs/api.md)
## Models
Splash supports these model families, with a matching DFlash2 draft selected
automatically:
| Model | GGUF example | MLX 4-bit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3.8-27B | `unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_M

## Install her: 7 steps
**Before you start:** Windows 10 or 11, an NVIDIA graphics card (RTX 20-series or newer, 8 GB of video memory) and
about 40 GB of free disk?
- **Yes** → STEP 1.
- **No** → talk to her in your browser instead: [mekahime.com/amika](https://www.mekahime.com/amika).
**Rather watch it?** The same 7 steps as a 3-minute video, with fixes and answers for when you get stuck:
[mekahime.com/openamikatutorial](https://www.mekahime.com/openamikatutorial).
### STEP 1 — Install Python 3.11 and Git
Takes about 5 minutes.
1. Click [python-3.11.9-amd64.exe](https://www.python.org/ftp/python/3.11.9/python-3.11.9-amd64.exe). Open it.
   Tick **Add python.exe to PATH** (bottom of the first window). Click **Install Now**.
2. Click [Git-2.56.0.4-64-bit.exe](https://github.com/git-for-windows/git/releases/download/v2.56.0.windows.4/Git-2.56.0.4-64-bit.exe).
   Open it. Click **Next** until it says **Install**, click **Install**, then **Finish**.
You see: "Setup was successful" (Python) and "Completing the Git Setup Wizard" (Git).
### STEP 2 — Open PowerShell in the folder where she will live
1. Press the **Windows key**, type `powershell`, press **Enter**. A normal window: not "Run as administrator".
2. Copy the line below. Click into the blue window. **Right-click** (that pastes). Press **Enter**.
```powershell
cd C:\
```
You see: `PS C:\>` and a blinking cursor.
Any drive works: `cd D:\` puts her on D:. Short paths work best. Not inside OneDrive.
### STEP 3 — Download OpenAmika
Paste each line, press **Enter**, wait for `PS ...>` to come back. Takes about a minute.
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika.git
```
```powershell
cd OpenAmika
```
You see: `PS C:\OpenAmika>`.
- If you see `'git' is not recognized` → close this wind
